agent spawns AI agents (claude, aider, agy) in g3d-termd sessions and
coordinates them: messages, status, permission prompts, and shared state, on
this host or across hosts linked by the agent bus.

Run "agent" alone for a short orientation (who you are, your agents, the bus);
"agent help <command>" has each command's details and examples.

Results go to stdout; a hint about what to do next may follow on stderr
(-q drops it). Exit codes: 0 done, 1 failed; wait exits 2 when it times out,
and friction add exits 3 when it finds a similar entry instead of filing.

If agent gets in your way, "agent friction add" tells the people who fix it.

Usage:
  agent [flags]
  agent [command]

Examples:
  agent spawn helper --backend claude
  agent send helper "summarize README.md" && agent wait helper --for idle --next
  agent state get helper _result

Agents:
  spawn       Start a new agent in its own g3d-termd session
  adopt       Create a bus entry for an existing g3d-termd session
  resume      Start an ended agent again, continuing its last session; --all: every one a reboot ended
  revive      Bring an ended agent back on its own conversation and re-brief it from its handoff doc
  attach      Open an agent's session in this terminal
  list        List the agents on this host (or another)
  cleanup     Stop agents and delete their records
  export      Print the agent tree for a program to read, and follow its changes
  sessions    List the agent sessions on this host, spawned by agent or not: the newest 25, or filtered

Fleet:
  fleet       Show the agents of this host and every linked peer, and what needs a look
  focus       Show, set or follow which agent has focus on a host
  template    Start agents from the templates a host agrees to run, from any host
  manage      See every agent and session with its tokens and state, and manage the data: untrack, back up, prune
  roster      Which harness and model to spawn: this host's roster, its notes, and pick

Messages:
  send        Send a message to an agent: typed in now, or held while it's busy
  queue       Queue a message, delivered when the agent is idle
  deliver     Type an agent's held messages in once it's at its prompt (send starts this)
  watch       Deliver queued messages as agents become idle (runs until Ctrl-C)

Status and waiting:
  status      Show whether an agent is idle, processing, waiting, ...
  statuses    Say what each status and end reason means
  wait        Block until agents reach a status (exit 2 on timeout)
  approve     Answer yes to an agent's permission prompt
  deny        Answer no to an agent's permission prompt
  capture     Print an agent's screen and recent scrollback
  logs        Print what an agent did (prompts, replies, tool calls), even after cleanup
  transcript  Print one session's events as JSON lines; --follow streams them as they happen
  events      Stream agent status events from the bus (runs until Ctrl-C)
  report      Record an agent's status by hand (claude/agy agents report automatically)
  hooks       Register gomuxai's hook with Claude Code for every session
  hook        The hook Claude Code runs on each event (installed by agent hooks install)

State and tasks:
  state       Read and write agents' key-value state
  task        Save reusable tasks, to spawn agents with

Jobs:
  run         Run a script as a job in its own memory-limited scope, and keep its record

Machines (bus):
  bus         Run and pair this host's agent bus

About this tool:
  friction    File what got in your way using agent, and read what others filed
  history     List recent agent commands run on this host
  skill       Teach Claude Code and agy how to use agent (a skill)
  version     Print which build of agent this is

Low-level sessions (session names, not agent names):
  session     Create, kill, and list raw g3d-termd sessions
  keys        Type text into a session (then Enter)
  key         Press a special key (Enter, Escape, c-c, ...) in a session

Additional Commands:
  help        Help about any command

Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -h, --help                    help for agent
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
      --version                 Print which build of agent this is

Use "agent [command] --help" for more information about a command.
